description: Plans and pricing for Septena, the task app (ADR 0010, ADR 0023, ADR 0036, ADR 0037, ADR 0045, ADR 0052, ADR 0059). One source for the pricing page, the in-app Septena Plus page and the upsell moments. `limits` holds the machine values per plan; the server plan table reads the same values. `cells` is the copy for each level, and the generator checks that every numeric limit appears in its cell. `prices` sell Plus and `proPrices` sell Pro (ADR 0059): both sit in one store subscription group, with Pro the higher level.
name: Septena Plus
headline: Free on one device. Plus on all of them.
subhead: Every task feature is free on the device you use. A free account adds a backup and lets you connect one agent. Plus covers all your devices, three agents, synced files and a longer history.

ladderHeadline: One device free. All devices on Plus. All your agents on Pro.

benefits.description: What each paid plan gives, one line per benefit, for the plan page, the plan sheet and onboarding (docs/PREMIUM_LANGUAGE.md). A benefit with a limit must state that plan's value. Pro lists only what it adds, then Everything in Plus.

plus.title: Every device, always current
plus.detail: Your list on all your devices, updated as you type.

plus.title: Three agents at work
plus.detail: Connect Claude and two more. Each one asks before it acts.

plus.title: 10 GB of synced files
plus.detail: Attach a file once and it opens on every device.

plus.title: A year of history
plus.detail: See who changed what, and bring back what you deleted.

pro.title: No limit on agents
pro.detail: Run as many agents on your list as your work needs.

pro.title: 50 GB of synced files
pro.detail: Room for scans, screenshots and long documents.

pro.title: Everything in Plus
pro.detail: Every device, a year of history and shared projects.

accountNote: Backup, history and your agent need a free account. The app does not.
agentNote: An agent is an AI you connect to your list, such as Claude.

fullApp.title: Every plan has the full task app

points.title: Every list, from Today to the Logbook
Areas, projects, sections, notes and attachments
Task conversations with the on-device model

cards.title: Free
cards.detail: The full task app on one device. You do not need an account.

cards.title: Septena Plus
cards.detail: Your list on every device, updated live.

cards.title: Septena Pro
cards.detail: For people who run many agents on one list.

outcomes.title: Your list everywhere
outcomes.detail: The same tasks on every device, updated as you type.

outcomes.title: Nothing lost
outcomes.detail: See who changed what and bring back what you deleted. Your files open on every device.

outcomes.title: Help that keeps working
outcomes.detail: Connect Claude or another agent to your list. It asks before it acts, and you can stop it at any time.

promises.title: The task app stays free
promises.detail: Tasks, lists, projects and areas have no caps on any plan.

promises.title: We never hold your data back
promises.detail: Export works on every plan. A limit hides older items. It never deletes them, and Plus shows them again.

promises.title: Cancel at any time
promises.detail: Your account becomes a free account. Every device keeps its tasks, and the server keeps your synced copy for 12 months.

promises.title: You pay your AI provider, not us
promises.detail: Septena runs the sync server and the connector. When you connect Claude or another agent, its bill stays with that provider.

upsells.title: This device is not syncing
upsells.detail: A free account syncs one device. Plus syncs all of them. You can also move your free account to this device.

upsells.title: Older changes are hidden
upsells.detail: A free account shows 30 days of history. Plus shows a full year.

upsells.title: This file is on another device
upsells.detail: Plus syncs files and images to all your devices.

upsells.title: Daily change limit reached
upsells.detail: Agents on this account made 500 changes today. They can make changes again tomorrow.

upsells.title: Sharing a project needs Plus
upsells.detail: Anyone can join a shared project for free. Plus lets you create one and invite people.

upsells.title: Your 14 days of Plus have ended
upsells.detail: Your account is now a free account. One device keeps syncing. Your tasks on every device stay where they are.

upsells.title: Your agent slot is in use
upsells.detail: A free account connects one agent. Plus connects three. Pro has no limit.

upsells.title: All three agent slots are in use
upsells.detail: Plus connects three agents. Pro connects as many as you run, and holds 50 GB of files.

paywall.trialBilling: If you subscribe during the trial, billing starts on the day you subscribe.
paywall.cancelNote: You can cancel at any time in Settings.
paywall.success: Plus is on. Your other devices start syncing.
paywall.serverRetry: Purchase received. Plus turns on when Septena reaches the server.
paywall.failed: The purchase did not go through. Try again in a moment.
paywall.ownedApple: You have Plus through the App Store.
paywall.ownedWeb: You have Plus through the web. Manage it at septena.app.
paywall.ownedGoogle: You have Plus through Google Play. Manage it in Google Play.
paywall.ownedGrant: Plus is on for this account.
paywall.ownedGrantPro: Pro is on for this account.
paywall.ownedOtherAccount: This Apple ID's Plus belongs to another Septena account. Sign in to that account to use it.
paywall.syncThisDeviceFailed: Septena could not reach the server. Try again in a moment.
paywall.upgradeNote: Pro starts right away. The App Store refunds the unused part of your Plus.
paywall.upgradeElsewhere: To move to Pro, change your plan in the store where you bought Plus.
paywall.buyElsewhere: This copy of Septena does not sell plans. Buy Plus or Pro in the App Store version on any device. It turns on here when you sign in to the same account.

status.filesSyncing: Files are still syncing between your devices.
